title: Cards Without Marks
description: A rating scale of RadioCard items in a RadioCardGrid with no RadioCardCheck, so the checked card shows its state with the brand fill and a second edge pixel. Each card stacks an aria-hidden icon above a RadioCardLabel word that names the option, and $minItemSize fits all five cards in one row. Use it for compact icon-and-word choices, like a satisfaction scale, where a check mark would crowd the card.
